def read_data(path='./'):
    """
    Read data from csv file into pandas DataFrame
    Args:
        path (str): path to the directory
    Returns:
        train_df: DataFrame of training data
        test_df: DataFrame of testing data
    """
    train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(path, 'train.csv'))
    test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(path, 'test.csv'))
    return train_df, test_df

def process_data(train_df, test_df):
    """
    Data processing for numerical columns
    Args:
        train_df (pd.DataFrame): DataFrame of training data
        test_df (pd.DataFrame): DataFrame of testing data
    Returns:
        train_X (csr_matrix): Sparse matrix of training data
        train_y (np.array): Numpy array of labels
        test_X (csr_matrix): Sparse matrix of testing data
        test_y (np.array): Numpy array of labels
    """
    train_y = train_df['label'].as_matrix()
    train_X = csr_matrix(train_df.drop(['label'], axis=1).as_matrix())
    test_y = test_df['label'].as_matrix()
    test_X = csr_matrix(test_df.as_matrix())
    return train_X, train_y
